extra.final_summary: The data had two issues: (1) the island label 'dream' was lowercase and needed normalization to 'Dream'; (2) three rows had negative flipper_length_mm values (-182, -210, -220) that were below the minimum allowed 170, so they were excluded. The sex column had 2 missing values, but they were not relevant to the question. After fixes, the average bill length for Adelie penguins was: Biscoe: 38.91 mm, Dream: 37.70 mm, Torgersen: 39.30 mm.
